Our Data Insights & Analytics team drives analytics, automation, and AI within Protection Management. In this internship, you will maintain and evolve the dashboards, automations, and data solutions that help SWISS manage aviation safety, security, and compliance risks.
Starting date
: October 01, 2026
Please apply in English.
Tasks
You will work on real-world use cases and help keep our analytics and automation tools reliable, relevant, and ready to support everyday operational decisions.
Maintain and enhance dashboards in Tableau and Power BI
Build and improve Power Automate flows and Power Apps use cases
Connect data sources into Microsoft Fabric and support semantic model documentation
Translate stakeholder needs into dashboard and automation solutions
Maintain process documentation in Confluence and support management of our analytics and automation portfolio
Benefits
Employee and networking events
Flight benefits
Company health management
25 days of annual vacation
Diversity programmes
Subsidized parking or public transport
Remote working (e.g. from home)
Flexible workhours and part-time working models
Discounts
Requirements
We are looking for a curious and reliable problem solver who enjoys building practical, working solutions and taking ownership of their delivery.
Master's student or graduate in Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or similar
Hands-on experience with Tableau and/or Power BI dashboarding
Experience or strong interest in Power Automate; familiarity with Power Apps a plus
Solid SQL and basic programming/scripting skills
Comf
